validation_constraints: start and end each contain exactly two signed int64 nanometer coordinates
the exact integer squared distances center-to-start and center-to-end are equal and nonzero
direction is exactly ccw or cw and major_arc is exactly boolean
the topology-indexed arc is not a full circle
the centerline has two vertices and one segment
all authored ids are nonzero uint64 values unique in their declared batch id space
width_nm is in the inclusive range 1 through 1000000000000
no angle, trigonometric value, or Geometer-selected rounding enters the A0 request

regeneration.canonical_fragment_bytes: lexicographically sorted UTF-8 records joined by LF with no trailing LF
steps: MATZ commits both operand updates and supplies the revised upstream ref, Git blob SHA-1, and fixture-content SHA-256
Geometer vendors the revised fixture byte-for-byte and updates the compatibility snapshot source ref, Git blob SHA-1, and both content SHA-256 values
Geometer projects case 2 to one A0 swept-path circular-arc segment per operand without consulting start_angle or sweep_angle
Geometer encodes the canonical GMABRQ01 request and records SHA-256 over the exact request attachment bytes
native executable IPC and browser WASM execute the identical request bytes and must return byte-identical successful result packets with no diagnostics
the strict decoder recomputes and records the standalone job-result SHA-256 for job 2
the case-2 fragment oracle and its SHA-256 are regenerated from the revised endpoint-authoritative input; the historical angle-form fragment list is not copied forward
an independent review confirms request identity, exact native-WASM parity, source lineage for operands 2001 and 2002, and the regenerated fragment oracle before case 2 is unblocked
